g.text: Legend: blue = current; amber dashed = planned #139 target; green = source verdict (fixed); red = blocked or terminal export state
Source verdict recorded; export cannot change it
Persist manifest, digest and collection time
Busy: another live lease, returns status busy
POST batch (bounded retries on 429, 502, 503, 504, connection errors)
Receiver partial rejection: terminal partial batch
Other HTTP errors or malformed ack: status failed, reason code
Lost acknowledgement after send: duplicate possible
Replay with same manifest, observed_at_ns and destination
Acknowledged batches suppressed; no request for them
Changed label, batch or serialization: replay_plan_mismatch
Grafana: Collector failed attempts and queue pressure; pre-Collector adapter planned
